title: Asics Padel W Tank Blazing Coral - Asics
description:
ASICS PADEL W TANK BLAZING CORAL - Style and comfort for your matches. Don't miss the latest from Asics padel for female players. The ASICS PADEL W TANK BLAZING CORAL is a women's sleeveless t-shirt perfect in design and materials, with which you will play safely, helping you breathe and facilitating freedom of movement. 

It is made of a breathable and elastic fabric that allows greater mobility and comfort during the game.

The design is predominantly coral pink. The "ASICS" brand logo is located on the left side.

Asics women's padel clothing.
